what.en: Line 2: the full address where the IRS returns the original documents and mails the ITIN decision. A US or foreign address both work. A USPS P.O. box is accepted, but not a private mailbox (PMB), and not a P.O. box or c/o address when line 3 holds only a country name.
what.zh: 第2行：IRS 寄回原件并寄送 ITIN 结果的完整地址。美国或境外地址均可。可用美国邮政（USPS）的邮政信箱，但不能用私营信箱（PMB）；如果第3行只填了国家名，第2行也不能用邮政信箱或“转交”（c/o）地址。

ifNone.en: Use the applicant's home address abroad; it may be the same address as line 3. Don't use a private mailbox or mail-forwarding service.
ifNone.zh: 填写申请人在境外的住址即可，可与第3行相同。不要使用私营信箱或代收转寄服务。

confirmations.quote: City or town, state or province, and country. Include ZIP code or postal code where appropriate.
complete foreign (non-U.S.) address in the country where you permanently or normally reside, even if it’s the same as the address on line 2
Don’t use a post office box owned and operated by a private firm or company.
If the foreign address is the same as the address on line 2, re-enter the address on line 3.

what.en: Line 3: the applicant's full street address outside the US, in the country where they permanently or normally live. No P.O. box and no c/o address. Someone who has moved to the US may write only the country, unless they chose reason b.
what.zh: 第3行：申请人在美国境外、长期或通常居住国家的完整街道地址。不得填写邮政信箱或“转交”（c/o）地址。已移居美国者可只填国家名，但选择理由 b 的除外。

ifNone.en: Every applicant fills this in with the street address of their permanent home abroad. If they have relocated to the US, enter only the country where they last lived; reason b still needs the full address of that last foreign home.
ifNone.zh: 每位申请人都要填写其境外长期住所的街道地址。若已移居美国，只填最后居住的国家；选择理由 b 的仍须填写最后一处境外住所的完整地址。

confirmations.quote: Street address, apartment number, or rural route number. Don’t use a P.O. box number.
enter the complete foreign (non-U.S.) address for your most recent residence in the country where you permanently or normally resided
Do not enter a post office box or an “in care of” (c/o) address on this line.

notes: Form W-7 (Rev. December 2024), its instructions (Rev. December 2024) and Publication 1915 (Rev. 12-2025). Both lines are the individual applicant's addresses, not a company's. Line 2 accepts any mailing address; line 3 must be a non-US street address.
